message: GR-001: publish ports on 127.0.0.1 only ("127.0.0.1:3000:3000"); a bare or 0.0.0.0 port mapping exposes the app to the network
GR-002/GR-003: SQL runs only in *.repository.ts files or api/src/kernel/db/, always scoped by userId
GR-003: no string-built SQL; use ? or @name placeholders
GR-005: session cookie must be HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax
GR-005: no CORS; the web reaches the api same-origin through the nginx proxy
GR-006: a module must not import from another module; use api/src/kernel/
GR-006: a feature must not import from another feature; use web/src/kernel/
GR-007: money is INTEGER minor units; no floating-point or decimal columns
GR-007: no floating-point money handling; use integer minor units and Intl for display
GR-008: never log passwords, hashes, cookies, session ids, CSV content, descriptions or amounts
GR-009: uploads are processed in memory and never written to disk
GR-009: no CSV export in v1 (formula-injection risk deferred)
GR-010: no weak or custom crypto; use argon2 for passwords and crypto.randomBytes for ids
GR-013: React output encoding only; never inject raw HTML
GR-013: no browser storage of tokens, sessions or data in v1
GR-015: .env.example lists variable names with empty values only
GR-016: no stack traces in responses; log errors through the pino err serializer
GR-017: run as a non-root user and pin base image tags (no :latest, no untagged FROM)
